[package]
name = "enigo"
version = "0.6.1"
authors = ["pentamassiv <pentamassiv@posteo.de>", "Dustin Bensing <dustin.bensing@googlemail.com>"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.87"
description = "Cross-platform (Linux, Windows, macOS & BSD) library to simulate keyboard and mouse events"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/enigo/"
homepage = "https://github.com/enigo-rs/enigo"
repository = "https://github.com/enigo-rs/enigo"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["simulate", "input", "mouse", "keyboard", "automation"]
categories = ["development-tools::testing", "api-bindings", "hardware-support", "os", "simulation"]
license = "MIT"
exclude = [".github", "examples", ".gitignore", "rustfmt.toml"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["x11rb", "wayland", "libei", "smol", "platform_specific", "serde"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = ["x11rb"]
tokio = ["ashpd/tokio", "dep:tokio"]
smol = ["ashpd/async-io"]
libei = ["dep:reis", "dep:futures", "dep:nom"]
platform_specific = []
serde = ["dep:serde"]
wayland = ["dep:wayland-client", "dep:wayland-protocols-misc", "dep:wayland-protocols-wlr", "dep:tempfile", "dep:nom"]
xdo = []
x11rb = ["dep:x11rb", "dep:nom"]
xdg_desktop = ["dep:image", "dep:futures", "dep:nom", "ashpd/screenshot"]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.62"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI_TextServices", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse", "Win32_UI_HiDpi"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
core-foundation = "0.10"
foreign-types-shared = "0.3"
dispatch2 = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.core-graphics]
version = "0.25"
features = ["highsierra"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-core-graphics]
version = "0.3"
features = ["CGEventTypes", "CGRemoteOperation"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2]
version = "0.6"
features = ["relax-void-encoding"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSEvent", "NSGraphicsContext", "objc2-core-graphics"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-core-foundation]
version = "0.3"
features = ["CFCGTypes"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "objc2-core-foundation", "NSGeometry"]

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
xkbcommon = "0.9"
xkeysym = "0.2"

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.reis]
version = "0.7"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.ashpd]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["remote_desktop", "screencast"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.24"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.wayland-protocols-misc]
version = "0.3"
features = ["client"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.wayland-protocols-wlr]
version = "0.3"
features = ["client"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.wayland-client]
version = "0.31"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.x11rb]
version = "0.14"
features = ["randr", "xinput", "xtest"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.tempfile]
version = "3"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.nom]
version = "8.0"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11"
tungstenite = "0.30"
url = "2"
webbrowser = "1.0"
ron = "0.12"
serde_json = "1.0"
strum = "0.28"
strum_macros = "0.28"
rdev = "0.5"
mouse_position = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[[example]]
name = "serde"
path = "examples/serde.rs"
required-features = ["serde"]

[[test]]
name = "integration_browser_events"
path = "tests/integration_browser.rs"
required-features = ["serde"]

[package]
name = "global-hotkey"
version = "0.7.0"
description = "Global hotkeys for Desktop Applications"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["windowing", "global", "global-hotkey", "hotkey"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/global-hotkey"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/global-hotkey"
categories = ["gui"]
rust-version = "1.85"

[features]
serde = ["dep:serde"]
tracing = ["dep:tracing"]

[dependencies]
crossbeam-channel = "0.5"
keyboard-types = "0.7"
once_cell = "1"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSEvent"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.59"
features = ["Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_SystemServices", "Win32_Graphics_Gdi", "Win32_UI_Shell", "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies]
xkeysym = "0.2.1"
futures = "0.3"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.x11rb]
version = "0.13.1"
features = ["xkb", "xinput"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.ashpd]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["async-std"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt-multi-thread", "time"]

[dev-dependencies]
winit = "0.30"
tao = "0.30"
eframe = "0.27"
iced = "0.13.1"
async-std = "1.12.0"

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-clipboard"
version = "2.1.11"
license = "MIT"
description = "A clipboard plugin for Tauri that supports text, html, rtf, files and image, as well as clipboard update listening."
authors = ["Huakun"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.70"
exclude = ["/examples", "/webview-dist", "/webview-src", "/node_modules"]
links = "tauri-plugin-clipboard"
repository = "https://github.com/CrossCopy/tauri-plugin-clipboard"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
rustc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[dependencies]
serde = "1.0"
thiserror = "1.0"
base64 = "0.22.1"
image = "0.25.1"

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.0.1"

[dependencies.clipboard-rs]
version = "0.3.4"
features = ["wayland"]

[build-dependencies.tauri-plugin]
version = "2.0.1"
features = ["build"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/0-don/enigo"]
git = "https://github.com/0-don/enigo"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "8575b177833318e4e18300cc541027f1877f2edc"

[source."https://github.com/0-don/global-hotkey"]
git = "https://github.com/0-don/global-hotkey"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "unified-wayland"

[source."https://github.com/0-don/tauri-plugin-clipboard"]
git = "https://github.com/0-don/tauri-plugin-clipboard"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
branch = "wayland-support"
